sloka: शरेण उरसि विव्याध सा पपात ममार च ।ताम् हताम् भीम संकाशाम् दृष्ट्वा सुरपतिः तदा ॥१-२६-२६॥
transliteration: śareṇa urasi vivyādha sā papāta mamāra ca ।tām hatām bhīma saṁkāśām dṛṣṭvā surapatiḥ tadā ॥1-26-26॥

translations.english: Having seen the slain yakshini of terrible appearance, Indra and other celestials worshipped Rama, exclaiming "well done, well done ".
